name: We Met v8.9.3 Light Theme + Classic Razorpay Popup
changes: Switches customer, listener and admin interfaces back to a clean light theme while preserving v8.9 mobile layouts
Restores wallet purchases to the classic Razorpay Standard Checkout popup pattern used by the older working customer build
Makes listener subscriptions open Razorpay directly from Subscribe without an intermediate We Met payment overlay
Removes razorpay-open full-screen/dark checkout presentation from active payment flows
Keeps existing server-side Razorpay order/subscription verification and wallet/membership refresh behavior
Updates legal pages, PWA theme colors and service-worker caches to the light theme
